title: [UE-0.8a] Owl dump and arena eval cameras

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The editor script writes every `DA_OwlPattern_*` and `DA_Phase_*` as JSON in the `encounter.json` shape. No owl assets exist yet (card 0.8b makes them)
- [ ] On the empty dump, `python3 tools/encounter_check.py --data` FAILS with E28 (pasted): the dump path works end to end. The 0 problems line is card 0.8b's
- [ ] `-EvalCam=CAM_Eval_Arena` and `-EvalCam=CAM_Eval_Stress` each log `EVALCAM_OK` (pasted)
